title: Future euro banknote design proposals
summary: The European Central Bank launched a public consultation inviting euro area citizens to share ideas and themes for future euro banknote designs, marking a significant democratic approach to currency modernization. This initiative represents a rare opportunity for public participation in shaping one of the world's most widely used currencies.
problem_solved: Modernizes euro banknotes while engaging citizens in the design process to ensure the currency reflects shared European values and identity.
why_valuable: Democratizes currency design decisions and allows European citizens to directly influence symbols and themes on their daily-use monetary instruments.
